meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会逐个通读代码库里的每一个源文件,大文件用 Read 工具的 offset 与 limit 参数分页读完,据此建立对整个代码库的了解。
howto.when: 当你开始接触一个新的或不熟悉的项目时,或你提到“学习代码库”、“读取代码库”、“快速上手”等说法时触发。

say.note: 它会逐个完整读完所有源文件

say.text: 先把这个项目的源码全部读一遍
say.note: 大文件会分页读取直到读完

say.text: 帮我上手这个不熟悉的项目
say.note: 读完后基于全部源码继续工作

howto.what_en: Claude reads through every source file in the codebase in full, paging large files with the Read tool's offset and limit parameters, to build an understanding of the whole project.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you start work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when you ask to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "get up to speed" or similar.

say_en.note: It reads every source file in full

say_en.text: Read through all the source code in this project first
say_en.note: Large files are paged until fully read

say_en.text: Help me get up to speed on this unfamiliar project
say_en.note: Then it continues based on all the source
